name: KY-006 passive piezo buzzer
not_buildable: It has to be driven with a fast square wave on an output pin. It is an output part, and LearnLens sketches may only switch the board's own LEDs so far.
identification: Small black PCB with 3 angled header pins at one end and a wide black cylinder with a hole in the top. The KY-012 active buzzer looks the same.

facts.statement: The passive buzzer produces tones between 1.5 kHz and 2.5 kHz when driven with a square wave; operating voltage 3.3 V to 5 V.
